contexts.text: Fifteen cubits and upwards did the waters prevail () = that there was nothing left... Fifteen = so little that there is scarcely anything; (for) five = a little; and as fifteen is composed of five... and ten, which = remains, it regards remains, which with those people were scarcely anything. AC 813.
The number 180 has its signification from twelve and fifteen...
On the fifteenth day of the second month ()... Fifteenth = what is new; because fourteen, or two weeks, = a whole period... Fifteen has a like signification to eight...
The fifteenth day of the seventh month () = the end of the former state and the beginning of a new one.
The hangings of the wing, of fifteen cubits () = truths in light as much as is sufficient.
